objective: Measure four nodes of eight reserved B200 GPUs each (32 GPUs total) through the NPA Soperator control plane
launcher: NPA Soperator owns deployment and teardown; Slurm starts one task per worker; torchrun starts eight ranks per task; FSDP shard degree eight; HSDP replica degree four
comparison: Keep source/model/data revisions, FP32 parameter storage, BF16 compute, EMA, packing, sample cap, global batch and seed identical to the completed eight/sixteen-GPU campaign. Record actual token work; do not assume exact equivalence from nominal batch alone.
accounting: Training GPU-hours use 32 GPUs. Report GPU allocation duration, CPU control plane, preparation, profiling and evaluation separately.
failure_policy: Preserve any failed attempt and exact native error. No silent precision, model, optimizer, dataset or sample-cap changes to obtain a fit.
status: protocol recorded before 32-GPU execution; plan and source preflight passed; reserved capacity insufficient; no provider deployment or measured result
deployment_comparability: Prior 8/16-GPU runs used native Slurm. Qualify and record the Soperator driver/CUDA/PyTorch/NCCL stack before execution; disclose deployment differences and reject pooled comparisons if runtime contracts differ. No pure GPU-count causal claim across different environments.
gpu_proof: 32 training processes attributed to rank, job and configuration
timestamped telemetry on all four workers
complete per-worker exit receipts and checkpoint hashes
